about.title: About
about.description: Folioneer is a personal portfolio manager designed to track your financial assets across multiple accounts. It lets you record purchases, monitor your positions, and follow your cost basis over time. All data is stored locally on your device.
about.up_to_date: The application is up to date.

settings.title: Settings
settings.auto_record_price_label: Automatically record transaction price as market price
settings.auto_record_price_description: When enabled, new transaction forms will have the auto-record checkbox pre-checked.
settings.auto_fetch_description: When enabled, the app fetches current prices from Yahoo Finance for all active holdings every time it starts.
settings.scheduled_fetch_description: Downloads closing prices and exchange rates once per day at the chosen time — even when the app is closed.

sync.title: Multi-device sync
sync.local_copy_note: The copy published to the shared folder is encrypted with your sync passphrase. The copy kept on this computer is not encrypted.
sync.no_recovery_note: If you forget the passphrase, the published copy cannot be decrypted and there is no way to recover it. You can still start over from any computer that holds the portfolio.
sync.metadata_exposure_note: Whoever hosts the folder can see file names, sizes and dates — so when and roughly how much the portfolio is used, and how many computers share it — but not your accounts, holdings or amounts.
sync.roster_empty: No other computer has joined yet.
sync.held_back: {{count}} change(s) waiting for records this computer has not received yet, the oldest since {{since}}.
sync.leave_confirm_message: This computer will publish its pending changes, then stop syncing. Its portfolio stays on this computer. It can only rejoin from a fresh installation.
sync.start_over_confirm_title: Start over with a new passphrase?
sync.start_over_confirm_message: Every file published to the shared folder will be discarded and every other computer will have to rejoin from a fresh installation.

enable_modal.title: Enable sync
enable_modal.folder_hint: A folder synchronised by your cloud client (Dropbox, Drive, Syncthing…) or on a USB key you carry between computers. The application never connects to the internet.

enable_modal.join_wording: This folder already holds a portfolio. Enter its sync passphrase to join from this fresh installation.
